integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect Prowlarr, Sonarr, Radarr and other Torznab apps
integrations.credentialsHint: Paste these values into your app. The API key keeps your passkey out of your apps' settings, and regenerating it cuts off apps using the old one. Torrents downloaded with it still carry your passkey: if the key leaks, regenerate it and ask staff to reset your passkey too.
integrations.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
integrations.rotateConfirm: Regenerate the API key? Apps using the current key stop working until you paste the new one.

prowlarr.name: Prowlarr
prowlarr.step1: In Prowlarr, open Indexers and click Add Indexer.
prowlarr.step2: Search for Generic Torznab and select it.
prowlarr.step3: Fill URL, API Path and API Key with the values above.
prowlarr.step4: Click Test, then Save. Prowlarr syncs the indexer to your connected Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr.

arr.name: Sonarr / Radarr / Lidarr
arr.step3: Fill URL, API Path and API Key with the values above.
arr.step4: Click Test, then Save. Running several apps? Use Prowlarr instead: you set the indexer up once.

other.name: Other apps
other.step1: Any Torznab client works: use the full endpoint above.
other.step2: Capabilities are listed at the endpoint with t=caps, no key needed.
other.step3: Search results link to .torrent files through your API key.
other.step4: Downloaded .torrent files already carry your passkey: nothing to configure in your torrent client.
